The only quests so far that gives this title now is from new adventure quest from OotP Chapter 1.5 "Sending it to the Starry Skies" (R9 Recognition, R11 Astronomy, French Language) Obtainable from London Adventurers Guild.

Pre-requisite : Custos Messium from quest Living Among the Skies (R7 Recognition, R9 Astronomy, French Language) obtained from Calicut Adventurers Guild.

Never know what this title give but i will try to search it later.
